unit.why: A single anecdote: on Yom Kippur at the Seer of Lublin's court, R. Moshe warms food for his dangerously ill brother R. Zvi, and the Seer links this to that day's fervent prayer.

stories.start_quote: עוד בהיותו מסתופף בצל רבו הקדוש
stories.summary_en: While staying with the Seer of Lublin, R. Moshe had to break Yom Kippur to cook and warm food for his dangerously ill brother R. Zvi. When he told the Seer, the Seer answered that now he knew why the prayer had been so 'hot' that day: R. Moshe had done the warming beneath it.

quotes: והוכרח אחיו הרבי ר״מ אז ביוה"כ לחמם
כי הי׳ חולה מסוכן ל"ע שמצוה בגדולי ישראל בזריזות
הוכרח לחלל יוה״כ עבורו בבישול וחימום
tags.why: Saving a life overrides Yom Kippur; the mitzvah is done by great men

quotes: ולא הי׳ יכול ליכנוס לבהמ"ד להתפלל

tags.why: The Yom Kippur prayer is the focus of the Seer's remark
The day's prayer was unusually fervent ('hot')
